findings.title: Non-Latin terminal-mark score (0.55) is below the detection threshold (0.6); core non-Latin detection silently drops questions on the LLM-unavailable path
findings.location: design.md Feature 1d + question_detector.py file-by-file entry; verified against question_detector.heuristic_detect (score += 0.55), interview_session._finalize_utterance (confidence >= detectionConfidenceThreshold), interview_config._DEFAULTS.detectionConfidenceThreshold == 0.6
findings.problem: A bare non-Latin question ending in ?/？/؟/। scores only 0.55 from the terminal mark (no English-lexicon tokens can match), so _finalize_utterance's >= 0.6 gate drops it. The 'never silently drop a non-English question' rule is contradicted whenever the LLM classifier path is not taken, which is exactly the offline/lenient-fallback case the design requires.
findings.fix: In the non-'en' path of QuestionDetector.detect, when the utterance is complete and ends in a terminal mark (? ？ ؟ । ! .) or meets minTranscriptChars, return confidence = max(heuristic, detectionConfidenceThreshold) (pin e.g. 0.6). Replace the lenient-fallback 'moderate confidence' wording with that concrete value and state it must be >= 0.6.

findings.title: Non-'en' 'force LLM path' interaction with base.complete and useLlmClassifier is unspecified
findings.location: design.md Feature 1d; verified against QuestionDetector.detect use_llm gate
findings.problem: The real use_llm gate requires useLlmClassifier, ai_module present, base.complete, and the ambiguous confidence band. The design says non-'en' bypasses the band but is silent on whether it also bypasses base.complete (would spend LLM calls on half-spoken fragments) and useLlmClassifier (would ignore the operator off-switch).
findings.fix: Pin the gate: use_llm = useLlmClassifier and ai_module is not None and base.complete and (lang != 'en' or AMBIGUOUS_LOW <= base.confidence <= AMBIGUOUS_HIGH). Non-'en' drops only the confidence-band condition; it still honors useLlmClassifier and base.complete. State this in Feature 1d and the file-by-file entry.

findings.title: Frontend start-frame capture test is not achievable as written: no exposed send seam, and freshSession never opens a socket
findings.location: design.md Testability 'Harness fix for frame capture'; verified against test/interview.test.js freshSession and interview.js ivSend/sttSend (private closures, lines 291/331)
findings.problem: Seeding state.ivWs/state.sttWs is necessary but not sufficient. The start frame is built inside start()/connectIvWs() (which open real sockets and call fetch, rejected by the sandbox), and ivSend/sttSend are module-private, so a test cannot trigger the send without invoking those networked functions.
findings.fix: Specify a testable seam: expose InterviewMode._sendStartFrame/_ivSend/_sttSend to assert the captured frame, OR route new WebSocket(...) through an injectable factory the sandbox stubs to return a capturing object with readyState=1 and stub fetch. Name the chosen seam in the design.

findings.title: Multi-language STT 'auto-detect' is unverifiable and slightly over-claimed
findings.location: design.md Feature 1b (2+ languages -> no hard hint)
findings.problem: Multi-language correctness is asserted to rely on STT auto-detect, which is model-dependent and unverifiable offline.
findings.fix: Add one sentence stating multi-language correctness rests on the classifier fallback whenever STT returns no in-set language, not on STT auto-detect.

findings.title: Resume distill truncation can drop later content with no user signal; char budgets are approximate
findings.problem: Resumes commonly exceed 6000 chars; the tail is dropped before the LLM sees it and nothing tells the user. Budgets are given as '~' approximations.
findings.fix: Pin the budgets as named constants; have the response 'chars' reflect pre-truncation extracted length and optionally return truncated:true so the UI can note it.

findings.title: distill form-field boolean parsing rule is contradictory for non-'true' strings
findings.problem: 'default true' plus 'parsed as "true"' is ambiguous for present-but-non-'true' values.
findings.fix: Pin: distill = request.form.get('distill','true').lower() != 'false' (absent -> true; explicit 'false' -> false; anything else -> true). State it so route and test agree.

findings.title: api_ask reaches into ai._language_instruction (module-private) across a module boundary without a fallback
findings.location: design.md UI design + server.py file-by-file (api_ask language append)
findings.problem: Calling the leading-underscore private from server.py is brittle; a future rename breaks /api/ask at request time, and the design's own defensive-import pattern is not applied here.
findings.fix: Promote to a public ai.language_instruction(...) and call that, OR guard with getattr(ai_helper, '_language_instruction', None) and skip the append (English behavior) if absent. State which.
